visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Running Total Instead of Re-Adding
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each waiting time is computed by adding up all earlier bursts again with a nested loop. Keep a running total instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A process waits as long as everything before it ran, which is the previous process's wait plus the previous burst. A running total gets each value from the last one in constant time.
